question: How is the embryo made in stone-born material?
premises: garbhaṃ kṛtvā navāṃśaṃ tu navadhā śailaje matam
inference: Having made the embryo, nine parts, ninefold, in stone-born material is the opinion.
uncertainties: Whether navāṃśaṃ and navadhā are the same or distinct is unclear.
plain_english: Having made the embryo, nine parts, ninefold, in stone-born material is the opinion.
